extracted.name: Garlic Mashed Potato Casserole
extracted.description: This cheesy garlic mashed potato casserole recipe, with a golden crust and buttery interior, is the ultimate comfort food. Make it ahead and freeze it.
ingredient_lines: 3 pounds Yukon Gold potatoes, or more as needed
3 cloves garlic, crushed and chopped, or to taste
instruction_lines: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with lightly salted water. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, about 20 minutes. Drain and return to pot.

Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Grease a glass baking dish. Combine milk, cream cheese, ⅓ cup green onions, butter, egg, garlic, and salt in a bowl; add to potatoes. Mash until smooth; transfer to the prepared baking dish. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese and remaining green onions.
Bake in the preheated oven until lightly browned, about 40 minutes.
